question: Does LinkStatic offer a free trial of a whole C-class range, or only of other plans?
why: unverified: behind a customer-service contact. The FAQ entry on the range page is shared by the single static ISP, enterprise ISP and TikTok line pages ('for some plans', claimed through customer service) and names no plan; the global resources page description ties its free-trial claim to the Standard and Premium plans of 7, 30 and 90 days; the trials found in forum promotions for the vendor are 7-day trials of one static ISP address (two in the United States, two in Japan, drawn from registered users), and the same promotions present the whole C-segment as a custom resource on request. No page names a range trial. Whether customer service grants one is behind a customer-service contact (online chat or Telegram) and was not asked.
